Every band ৬ on this page is printed inside a ring next to the ringed ∧ at an ayah end; recorded with enclosure 'circle'.

Row 0: the solid down arrow and the ringed ∧ above اَكْبَرُۘ (small meem waqf lazim, 68:33) sit over the ر/ب/ك area; both anchored to the final ر. Arrow labelled from the right-margin note (মীম ওয়াকফি লাযীম).

The band arrow above it is anchored to the last letter of لَكُمْ and labelled from the right-margin note; one word in that note is printed in Arabic script (read as سکتہ) and is uncertain.

Rows 4 and 5: the waqf over circle ৪০ and after شُرَكَآءُ (68:41) is three dots stacked over a small ج; encoded as ۛ only. The band arrows above them are labelled from the right-margin note (ওয়াকফি মুআনাক্বা).
Row 9: تَسْئَلُهُمْ is printed with the hamza on a tooth (ئ) carrying a fatha; written with ئ rather than the Indo-Pak tatweel form.
Row 10: band ২ and ম over اَجْرًا both anchored to the ر with tanween; row 10 ম over مَّغْرَمٍ sits over the ر (not the غ) and is anchored to ر.
